## Context / Problem
Story gunshy-symmetric-barnacle (bf96-5776-6a97-420f) moves the reconciler from `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` to `src/rebar/reconciler/`. The ruff per-file ignore that exempts the reconciler's operational `print()` output from T201 is `"src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*" = ["T201"]` in `pyproject.toml` (`[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]`, line 567 on origin/main c0cf1022671), and its glob no longer matches anything after the move. Any edit to `pyproject.toml` counts as touching the dependency map, so the Gerrit pip-audit lane (`scripts/dependency_audit.py::touches_dependency_map`, "if you touch it, you own it") blocks such a change on the advisories open under unhelpful-supersmart-chrysalis (f7dc-132b-057a-476c). Following the operator's decision on change 3038 (leave `pyproject.toml` untouched, file the stale-line cleanup as a follow-up), the move story leaves `pyproject.toml` alone and puts an inline `# noqa: T201` on each reconciler `print()` site (100 sites in 33 files, added with `ruff check --select T201 --add-noqa src/rebar/reconciler`).

## Approach
1. In `pyproject.toml`, replace `"src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*" = ["T201"]` with `"src/rebar/reconciler/**" = ["T201"]`, and update the comments that name the old path (`:14`, `:68`, `:509`, `:627-634`).
2. Remove the inline `# noqa: T201` markers from `src/rebar/reconciler/**`, leaving every other noqa code on those lines intact.
3. Land it only after unhelpful-supersmart-chrysalis closes (the lane stops blocking), or bundle it into the change that remediates those advisories, since that change already owns `uv.lock`/`pyproject.toml`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `grep -n 'rebar_reconciler' pyproject.toml` prints nothing.
- [ ] `git grep -c 'noqa: T201' -- src/rebar/reconciler` prints nothing.
- [ ] `ruff check --select T201 src/rebar/reconciler` reports no findings, and `make lint` passes.
- [ ] The Gerrit pip-audit lane passes on the change.
compiled_state.title: Move the T201 per-file ignore glob from `_engine/rebar_reconciler/*` to `reconciler/*` and drop the inline noqa once the lock advisories clear
